latestVersion.changelog:
Movie Clip Maker 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly create and export high-quality 1080p movie clips by describing your edits, no manual timeline needed.
- Seamless upload, edit, and export workflow using cloud processing — results ready within 30-90 seconds.
- Automatic authentication with free anonymous tokens (100 free credits, valid for 7 days).
- Simple commands for uploading, viewing status, checking credits, and exporting in multiple formats.
- Built-in error handling for common issues like token expiry, file size/type, and rate limits.
- Designed for quick social-ready video edits: just drop your footage and type your instructions.
